state.title: tests/Database/DatabaseSchemaBlueprintTest.php

part.text: The fix is in `Blueprint::foreignIdFor` — when the key type is `int`, it should create a bigint column regardless of whether the model is incrementing:

All 33 tests in `DatabaseSchemaBlueprintTest` pass, including `testGenerateRelationshipColumnWithNonIncrementalModel` which now produces `bigint unsigned` instead of a UUID char column.

The fix: removed the `$model->getIncrementing()` check in `foreignIdFor` (src/Illuminate/Database/Schema/Blueprint.php:1460) so any model with `int` key type gets a `foreignId` (bigint unsigned) column — non-incrementing models no longer fall through to the UUID branch.
